`ShareResourceClaimSequentially` is the slowest and runs twice. It's designed to stress pod scheduling, so that's not surprising.

It's not the total runtime. I also saw it fail once locally after splitting into smaller packages. Even in case of a timeout it would be suspicious that `UsesAllResources` times out: it's usually pretty fast, so clearly something gets wedged occasionally.

I am able to run the test locally:
```
$ go test ./test/integration/dra/
go: downloading go1.26.0 (linux/amd64)
ok      k8s.io/kubernetes/test/integration/dra  519.603s
```
